# Pickering Heating & Cooling

> From its base in Pickering, Durham Region, Pickering Heating & Cooling serves homeowners with residential HVAC work: emergency furnace repair, AC tune-ups and replacements, ductless mini-splits, cold-climate heat pumps, gas fireplaces, thermostats, and duct cleaning.

Phone: (905) 831-4059  |  Email: contact@pickeringheatingcooling.ca  |  Website: https://pickeringheatingcooling.ca

Service areas: Pickering, Ajax, Whitby, Oshawa, Bowmanville, Newcastle, Courtice, Port Hope
